summary.content:
Today's selection covers 97 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 20 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI is planning a desktop ‘superapp’
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Security Firm Aura Discloses Data Breach Impacting 900,000 Records
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 45 articles published in the last 24 hours
